messages:
alex wang: Morning — quick async check. Kestrel Therapeutics wants on‑prem keywrap/HSM details before we can finalize the Dedicated pilot contract. Demo is Wed 10am. Blocker: security needs to confirm HSM key wrapping/process and whether we can support their BYOK flow. Can someone from security take point?

secops-bot: Heads up — submitted a ticket to secops queue (SOP-8392) for HSM checklist, tagging @pri ya for triage.

priya singh: I can take the triage. Alex, can you drop the customer architecture + their compliance requirements in this thread (or DM me)? I need the expected key lifecycle, whether they require attestation, and if they expect HSM certs to rotate automatically. :eyes:

alex wang: Copy — attaching the short summary here: Kestrel will host in their VPC, expects FIPS 140-2 HSM, wants keywrap for model checkpoint encryption, and needs an audit trail for key ops. They asked if Redwood can integrate with their Azure Key Vault HSM or if we provide a gateway.

michael ramos: Quick pipeline update: closed deal with ZetaHealth yesterday (signed PO). Kestrel is still in legal review — they asked for an onprem exception clause for our telemetry agents. I pinged legal, but would love a clarity note from SecOps re: what telemetry we absolutely need to retain for SLA observability.

tanisha chaudhry: For telemetry: short answer — we need per-request latency+error counts, sampling of prompt/response metadata (no raw PII). I can write a 1-pager for legal that describes retention windows and redaction capabilities. I can also outline how the agent supports an opt-out for sensitive fields.

jordan lee: I created a short 30m slot tomorrow 3pm for product+sales+secops to sync (calendar invite sent). If that works we'll convert it to a recurring touchpoint while the pilot is active.

priya singh: Alex — pinged @legal as well (legal@redwood). Also, secops question: will Kestrel's BYOK require an HSM in our network or can we do an outbound integration to their HSM? If we must host an HSM, that's a deployment change and may affect Dedicated pricing.

michael ramos: PR ping: there is an internal PR that adds keywrap support in the agent (PR#4521). It's awaiting review from eng-runtime. @tanisha can you prioritize a high-level comment for legal from your 1-pager? That will unblock legal's redline.

tanisha chaudhry: Will do — aiming to post the 1-pager by EOD. Also tagging eng-runtime channel to request a quick review of PR#4521 for compatibility notes. :thumbsup:

alex wang: Thanks — two action items for me: 1) share Kestrel's architecture doc in DM to @pri ya, 2) prep demo checklist for Wed (I'll share by EOD). Priya/tanisha/michael — appreciate owning the security/legal threads.

secops-bot: Reminder: security triage ticket SOP-8392 updated with attachments from Alex at 2026-03-16T14:12:00Z.

jordan lee: Small note on logistics: if the customer requests an on-prem HSM install, we'll need a site-prep checklist (network ranges, ops window, contact). I'll draft and post in #vendors later today.

alex wang: Great. If anyone hits blockers before tomorrow's sync, drop quick updates here. Otherwise, see you in the 3pm slot. :pray:
